title: About The Proud Paintbrush | Sugar Land & Fort Bend Painters
metaDescription: Meet The Proud Paintbrush — a locally owned, insured painting company serving Sugar Land & Fort Bend County since 2020. Our story, vision & values.
bodyHtml:
The Proud Paintbrush is a locally owned, insured painting company based in Sugar Land, Texas. Since 2020 we have helped homeowners across Sugar Land, Missouri City, Katy, Richmond, Fulshear, Rosenberg, and the greater Houston area protect and beautify the place they care about most — their home.

Our name says it all: we believe you should take pride in your home, and we take pride in every brushstroke that gets it there. We are not a national franchise — we are your neighbors. Every estimate, every prep step, and every finished wall is backed by our own written workmanship warranty and a 5.0-star reputation across 124 Google reviews.

Our Story

What began as one painter who refused to cut corners has grown into a trusted Fort Bend County team known for honest communication and results that last. Learn how The Proud Paintbrush started and what drives us every day.

Read our story →

Our Vision

We have a big, bold vision for a more beautiful Fort Bend County — one home, one street, and one community at a time. See where we are headed and why it matters to us.

Explore our vision →

Our Core Values

Preparation, communication, craftsmanship, and accountability guide everything we do. These are the standards we hold ourselves to on every project — long after the final walkthrough.

See our core values →

More About The Proud Paintbrush

  • Our Warranty — our real, written 2 & 5-Year Written Warranty.
  • Reviews & Testimonials — video reviews and 5-star feedback from local homeowners.
  • Service Areas — the Fort Bend County and Houston communities we serve.
  • Paint It Forward — how we give back to our community.
  • Careers — join our growing team of professional painters.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is The Proud Paintbrush located?

We are based in Sugar Land, Texas (77498) and serve Fort Bend County and the greater Houston area, including Missouri City, Katy, Richmond, Fulshear, Rosenberg, West Houston, and Southwest Houston.

Are you insured?

Yes. The Proud Paintbrush carries general liability insurance with a $1,000,000 limit, and a certificate of insurance is available on request. We have been locally owned since 2020. (Note: Texas does not require a state license for residential painting contractors.)

Do you stand behind your work?

Always. Every project is backed by our 2 & 5-Year Written Warranty — a 2-year standard workmanship warranty, with a 5-year upgrade available on qualifying projects.
